title: US nutrition startup Berry Street merges with India’s Healthify as GLP-1 trends upwards
summary: U.S. nutrition startup Berry Street said on Monday it has merged with Khosla Ventures-backed Indian startup Healthify to bank on the popular trend of people turning to GLP-1 drugs to lose weight.
